description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the CustomField class within the Opencart system, specifically for account-related custom field handling. It extends a base controller class and includes methods to retrieve custom fields based on customer group ID and output them as JSON.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for managing custom fields associated with customer accounts, providing endpoint to retrieve custom field data based on customer group.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of preparing and returning custom fields as a JSON response based on the customer group ID.
